response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, CAST(analysis_count AS REAL) / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM counts;
